title: The Cipher of the Green Zone
author: August Joubert
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
